From: Lea Stone
To: Noel Ash
Date written: October 28, 1841
Subject: Archive notice
Message-ID: MAIL-10403
On October 25, 1841, Lea Stone sent the orchard inventory. This record was
written on October 28, 1841.
Inventory leaf 1. The archive cupboard held a woolen cover beside an unrelated register. No dispatch is recorded here.
